 The debut edition of HOME Music Festival Goa 2026 is set to light up Vagator Hills on December 29 and 30 with Arijit Singh and Karan Aujla to headline the event. Here is everything you need to know about the HOME Music Festival Goa 2026, including dates, time, venue, ticket booking details and the full artist lineup.  The last week of December in Goa has its own kind of magic. Beach clubs hum, evenings stretch well past midnight, and the whole year starts to feel like one long party. This year, there’s another reason to pack your bags. HOME Music Festival Goa 2026 is coming to Vagator on December 29 and 30, and its debut edition is headlined by two of India’s biggest names, Arijit Singh and Karan Aujla. Organised by Team Innovation, this two-day, multi-genre festival runs from 1 pm to 10 pm each day. More than 30 Indian artists are on the bill, covering mainstream, independent and electronic music. Wondering about the schedule and who's performing? Here is everything you need to know about HOME Music Festival Goa 2026 including dates, time, venue, how to book tickets, presale and general sale details.
 HOME Music Festival Goa 2026: Dates, Time And Venue
 Block out December 29 and 30, 2026. The HOME Music Festival Goa 2026 takes place at Vagator Hills in Vagator, Bardez, Goa, with performances running from 1 pm to 10 pm IST on both days. It’s backed by Goa Tourism and supported by the Government of Goa.
 Since the year-end rush already pulls crowds to the coast, HOME gives you a ready-made plan: build your Goa getaway around two days of live music. Food and beverages will be available at the venue, so you won’t have to step out mid-set.
 HOME Music Festival Goa 2026: How To Book Tickets
 Tickets are being sold on thumpN and District by Zomato. Sales are split into two phases: an exclusive HSBC Visa Credit Card presale, followed by general sale.
 Here’s how to book your tickets:
 Head to the official HOME Festival event page on thumpN or District, then log in or create an account.
 For the HSBC Visa Credit Card presale, the booking page opens on October 31, 2026, at 2 pm IST and closes on November 2 at 1 pm IST. You’ll need an eligible HSBC Visa credit card to pay.
 For general sale, go back to either platform from November 2 at 2 pm IST onwards.
 Pick your ticket category and quantity, fill in the attendee details and complete the payment.
 Save your booking confirmation and digital ticket, since you’ll need it at the gate.
 Ticket categories and availability will be shown on the booking platforms.

 The headline pairing is the big draw here. Arijit Singh and Karan Aujla will share a festival bill for the first time, putting two very different musical worlds on one stage. It’s also a first for Goa: HOME marks Arijit’s first-ever public performance in the state, while Karan Aujla will make his first public ticketed concert appearance there.
 The supporting lineup has something for every taste. Jasleen Royal, DJ Chetas and KING lead the pack, joined by Banjaare, Aarzu Boys featuring Khan and Noor, Afterall, Ali Merchant, Garvit-Priyansh, Gini, Jasmin Walia, Lijo, Mali, MXRCI, Siroyi and W.i.S.H.
 If electronic and underground sounds are more your thing, look out for Pro Bros, Tech Panda x Kenzani, Aadyaa, Avneet Music, Dhyan Live, Felix, HRX, Mayur Jumani, Neel Chhabra, Nitish Wadhwa, PRFCT & D’ARK, Rohan Mukati, Sazi and Techtronix. The day-wise schedule hasn’t been announced yet, so keep checking for updates.
